text: 如果我（男）剩到了40岁，为什么还要结婚？
en: If I (a man) were still single at 40, why would I even get married?

text: 剩下来的男人，年轻时候大多数都被女人嫌弃过，或者穷过，才会一直剩下的，当然，也有一些是工作问题导致剩下的，但是结果都一样。
en: The men who remain single, most of them were looked down on by women when they were young, or had been poor, which is why they stayed single; of course, some were left single because of work issues, but the result is the same.

text: 那就是，荷尔蒙已经低下来了，生活也已经安定下来了，为什么要想不开让一个女人来打搅自己的生活，花我的钱？
en: That is, the hormones have already dropped, and life has already settled down, so why be so foolish as to let a woman disturb one's life and spend one's money?

text: 就像女人说的，她不是过来做保姆的，所以我们也不会因为需要一个保姆娶一个女人，雇一个真正的保姆比老婆便宜多了。
en: Just as women say, she is not coming to be a nanny, so we would not marry a woman just because we need a nanny; hiring a real nanny is far cheaper than a wife.

text: 40岁结婚唯一的理由就是孩子，以优生学来说，别说40岁，30岁都大了。
en: The only reason to marry at 40 is children; from the standpoint of eugenics, never mind 40, even 30 is already old.

text: 因为你在大城市活得太久了。
en: Because you have lived in the big city for too long.

text: 有空去偏远的农村看看，很多光棍村，别说40了，只要是个母的他们就要。
en: When you have time, go and take a look at remote villages; there are many bachelor villages where, never mind 40, they would take anyone female.

text: 热知识：男人结婚是为了有孩子
en: Well-known fact: men marry in order to have children.

text: 热知识2：40岁男人有繁殖能力，但是40岁女人没有
en: Well-known fact 2: a 40-year-old man has fertility, but a 40-year-old woman does not.

text: 实际上，一个自律的40岁男人，如果注意保养健身锻炼，且自信稳重成熟，那么这个男人对女人的吸引力是比稚气未脱的小年轻要大得多的，尤其是对20岁左右的年轻小妹的吸引力。
en: In fact, a self-disciplined 40-year-old man, if he takes care of himself, keeps fit and exercises, and is confident, steady and mature, is far more attractive to women than an immature young lad, especially to young women of around 20.

text: 有人说主要还是有钱才行，这个也不错，但是对大多数女人来说，其实所谓的有钱并不是指你一定要富得流油的，只要能保证正常的小康生活，大多数女人是知足的，而作为一个自律的成熟稳重的中年男人，如果连基本的小康生活都保证不了，那说明你的自律成熟稳重都是假的。
en: Some say the main thing is still that you need to be rich, which is also fair, but for most women, being 'rich' does not actually mean you have to be filthy rich; as long as you can guarantee a normal moderately comfortable life, most women are content. And for a self-disciplined, mature and steady middle-aged man, if you cannot even guarantee a basic moderately comfortable life, then your self-discipline, maturity and steadiness are all fake.

text: 有一个算一个
en: Every single one of them.

text: 35+女的，你请他人均1000的日料
en: A woman of 35 or over, you take her to Japanese food averaging 1000 per person.

text: 嘴角都不带翘一下
en: She would not even crack a smile.

text: 这么多年社会跌打滚爬
en: After so many years of struggling through society.

text: 对男人的好感度阈值已经高到离谱了
en: Her threshold for feeling any favour towards a man is absurdly high.

text: 这时候入局
en: To enter the scene at this point.

text: 只是她无奈的将就
en: Is only her helpless settling.

text: 所以何必呢
en: So why bother.

text: 这个男人身高一般，长相普通，家境还不太行。
en: This man is of average height, plain-looking, and his family background is not great either.

text: 在相亲市场上，备受冷眼。
en: In the matchmaking market, he gets the cold shoulder.

text: 于是他痛定思痛，发愤图强，暂时放下个人感情问题。
en: So he reflected on his pain, resolved to strive, and temporarily set aside his personal romantic issues.

text: 一番打拼，到40岁总算挣到令人羡慕的财富。
en: After a spell of struggle, by 40 he finally earned enviable wealth.

text: 不管别人怎么看，起码他自认为在择偶上有了局部优势。
en: No matter what others think, at least he believes he has gained a partial advantage in mate selection.

text: 结果你让他娶个40岁的女人？
en: And the result is you want him to marry a 40-year-old woman?

text: 你干嘛不直接杀了他！
en: Why don't you just kill him!

text: 至于那些到40岁还没能力娶老婆的，放心，他们不敢去你的平台登记，他们是愿意娶40岁女人的。
en: As for those who by 40 still have no ability to take a wife, rest assured, they dare not register on your platform; they are willing to marry 40-year-old women.

text: 做婚介的人看到的往往比统计表还真。
en: What those in the matchmaking business see is often more real than the statistical tables.

text: 年轻姑娘追不到，同龄的又不看，就这么一个人耗着，这个现象确实普遍。
en: Cannot win over a young girl, and peers will not look at him; just dragging on alone like this — this phenomenon is indeed common.

text: 只是”宁可单着”这四个字要稍微打个折扣，后面会讲到，这批人里有不少只是还在等，过几年会慢慢松口。
en: It is just that the phrase 'would rather stay single' needs a slight discount; as will be explained later, quite a few of this group are only still waiting, and will slowly relent after a few years.

text: 下面只说多数情况，个例不论。
en: Below we only discuss the majority of cases; individual exceptions are not considered.

text: 两拨人其实不在同一个池子里
en: The two groups of people are actually not in the same pool.

text: 很多人以为大龄未婚男女数量差不多，男的挑一挑总能挑到。
en: Many people think the number of older unmarried men and women is about the same, and that a man can always pick and choose and find someone.

text: 看一下国家统计局的抽样数据就知道，两边的人数和成分都对不上。
en: A look at the sampling data from the National Bureau of Statistics shows that the numbers and composition on the two sides do not match up.

text: 《中国人口和就业统计年鉴2023》收录了2022年全国抽样调查的婚姻状况数据，整理出来是这样的：
en: The China Population and Employment Statistics Yearbook 2023 includes data on marital status from the 2022 national sample survey, and it is organised as follows:

text: 年龄组	男性未婚	男性离婚	女性未婚	女性离婚
en: Age group	Men never married	Men divorced	Women never married	Women divorced

text: 数据来源是《中国人口和就业统计年鉴2023》中2022年全国抽样调查的分年龄、性别婚姻状况表，其中40-44岁男性未婚6.4%、离婚5.2%，同龄女性未婚2.3%、离婚3.9%。
en: The data source is the age- and sex-specific marital status table from the 2022 national sample survey in the China Population and Employment Statistics Yearbook 2023, in which 40-44-year-old men who never married are 6.4% and divorced 5.2%, while same-age women who never married are 2.3% and divorced 3.9%.

text: 这张表能看出两件事。
en: This table shows two things.

text: 第一件事是，40出头从没结过婚的男人，比例差不多是同龄女人的三倍。
en: The first is that men just over 40 who have never married are, in proportion, almost three times that of same-age women.

text: 男多女少是人口结构决定的。
en: More men than women is determined by population structure.

text: 国家统计局发言人付凌晖2021年介绍七普结果时说过，20-40岁适婚年龄段男性比女性多1752万人。
en: Fu Linghui, spokesperson for the National Bureau of Statistics, said when introducing the results of the seventh national census in 2021 that among those aged 20-40 in the marriageable age range, men outnumber women by 17.52 million.

text: 第二件事更关键。
en: The second thing is more crucial.

text: 40-44岁单身女性里，离婚的(3.9%)比从没结过婚的(2.3%)还多，大概六成是离异的。
en: Among single women aged 40-44, the divorced (3.9%) outnumber those who never married (2.3%), and roughly 60% are divorced.

text: 所以你平台上那些”40女”，很大一部分是带着婚史、甚至带着孩子来的。
en: So those '40 women' on your platform, a large portion come with a marital history, even with children.

text: 对一个从没结过婚的男人，这意味着一进门可能就要当继父。
en: For a man who has never married, this means that the moment he steps in he may have to become a stepfather.

text: 他嘴上说的是”不要40的”，心里嫌的往往是”二婚带娃”这个组合。
en: What he says is 'I don't want a 40-year-old', but what he really minds is often the combination of 'divorced with children'.

text: 再看学历。
en: Now look at educational level.

text: 国家统计局2012年出的《中国社会中的女人和男人》里有个数据，2010年小学及以下文化程度的适龄人群中，女性未婚比例2.5%，男性高达11.1%；研究生以上学历的女性未婚比例却有49.2%，比男性高10.1个百分点。
en: In the 2012 National Bureau of Statistics publication Women and Men in Chinese Society, there is a figure: among the marriageable-age population with primary school education or below in 2010, the proportion of unmarried women was 2.5% and men as high as 11.1%; yet among women with postgraduate education or above, the unmarried proportion was 49.2%, 10.1 percentage points higher than men.

text: 把这两组数放在一起，画面就出来了。
en: Put these two sets of numbers together, and the picture emerges.

text: 大龄未婚男，偏向低学历、低收入、小地方；大龄未婚女，偏向高学历、城市、经济独立。
en: Older unmarried men tend towards low education, low income, small places; older unmarried women tend towards high education, cities, economic independence.

text: 条件普通的40男和没结过婚的40女，很多根本生活在两个世界里，碰都碰不上。
en: An ordinary 40-year-old man and a 40-year-old woman who has never married often live in completely different worlds and never even cross paths.

text: 能在你平台上碰到的同龄女，多半又是离异带娃的。
en: The same-age women he can meet on your platform are, more often than not, divorced with children.

text: 所以你问”为什么普通男也不要同龄女”，第一个答案很朴素：他能碰到的同龄女，和他理想中那个”没结过婚的同龄女”，经常不是同一拨人。
en: So when you ask 'why ordinary men don't want same-age women either', the first answer is quite plain: the same-age women he can meet and the 'same-age women who have never married' in his ideal are often not the same group of people.

text: 他想结婚的头号理由，40岁的女人很难给
en: The number-one reason he wants to marry, a 40-year-old woman can hardly provide.

text: 这批男人想结婚，动力最大的一条通常是要个孩子，给爹妈一个交代。
en: The biggest driver for this group of men wanting to marry is usually to have a child, to give his parents an explanation.

text: 越是小地方、越是家里老人催得紧的，这条越重。
en: The smaller the place and the harder the elders at home press, the heavier this weighs.

text: 偏偏40岁是女性生育力下滑最快的阶段。
en: Yet 40 is precisely the stage at which female fertility declines fastest.

text: 美国妇产科医师学会(ACOG)的说法是，女性生育力30岁出头开始缓慢下降，37岁后下降加快，到40岁每个周期自然受孕的概率只有5%左右。
en: According to the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG), female fertility begins to decline slowly in the early thirties, falls faster after 37, and by 40 the probability of natural conception per cycle is only about 5%.

text: 试管也没法完全补救，按美国辅助生殖技术协会(SART)数据，用自己卵子做试管，每个周期的活产率从38岁的约26%降到41岁的约13%(这个数字是美国的统计口径，国内不同医院差异挺大，只能当量级参考)。
en: IVF cannot fully remedy this either; according to data from the Society for Assisted Reproductive Technology (SART), for IVF with one's own eggs, the live birth rate per cycle falls from about 26% at 38 to about 13% at 41 (these figures use the American statistical definition; domestic hospitals vary considerably, so they can only serve as an order-of-magnitude reference).

text: 你站在他的角度想一下就明白了。
en: Think about it from his perspective and you will understand.

text: 结婚这件事，对他来说最大的回报是孩子。
en: For him, the greatest return from marriage is a child.

text: 一旦对方大概率生不了，这桩婚姻在他心里就从”成家”变成了”搭伙过日子”。
en: Once the other party is very likely unable to bear children, in his mind this marriage changes from 'starting a family' to 'keeping house together'.

text: 搭伙过日子他一个人也能过，何必呢。
en: He can keep house alone just as well; so why bother.

text: 不过这里有个他自己不太愿意面对的事实。
en: Yet there is a fact here that he is rather unwilling to face.

text: 男人的生育力也在掉，40多岁要孩子，等孩子上大学他已经60了。
en: Men's fertility is also declining; if he has a child in his forties, by the time the child goes to university he will already be 60.

text: 找个25岁的姑娘，生孩子的问题解决了一半，养孩子的问题一点没少。
en: Finding a 25-year-old girl solves half the childbearing problem, but not one bit of the child-rearing problem.

text: 只是这笔帐他通常不会往下想。
en: It is just that he usually does not think this calculation through.

text: 还有一类40男压根不打算要孩子，那生育就解释不了他为什么不要同龄女，原因得往下面几节找。
en: There is also a type of 40-year-old man who has no intention of having children at all, in which case fertility cannot explain why he does not want a same-age woman; the reason must be sought in the sections below.

text: 她要的东西他给不起，干脆先说”我不要”
en: What she wants, he cannot afford to give, so he simply says first 'I don't want it'.

text: 你自己总结得很准，多数40女想找同龄或年长几岁的、经济比她好的、成熟稳重能照顾她的。
en: You summarised it very accurately: most 40-year-old women want someone of the same age or a few years older, better off economically than her, mature and steady who can take care of her.

text: 问题就在这。
en: The problem lies right here.

text: 对一个条件普通的40男，这份要求清单基本是一张他考不过的试卷。
en: For an ordinary 40-year-old man, this list of requirements is essentially an exam paper he cannot pass.

text: 收入要比她高，他可能不如人家；要能照顾她，他自己的日子都过得紧巴巴。
en: His income may be lower than hers; and to take care of her, his own life is already lived on a tight budget.

text: 人被拒绝是很难受的，尤其到了40岁还没成家，自尊心早就攒了一堆伤。
en: Being rejected is very painful, especially having reached 40 without a family, when self-esteem has long accumulated a pile of wounds.

text: 最省事的保护办法就是抢先一步：”我还看不上她呢，我要找年轻的。
en: The easiest way to protect himself is to strike first: 'I don't even fancy her; I want to find someone young.'

text: ”这话说出来，面子保住了，也不用真去试。
en: Saying this, his face is saved, and he does not have to actually try.

text: 这里有个挺扎心的不对称。
en: There is a rather piercing asymmetry here.

text: 年轻姑娘对他来说是个想象中的选项，同龄女是摆在面前的真实选项。
en: A young girl is an imagined option for him, while a same-age woman is a real option right in front of him.

text: 想象中的选项永远不会拒绝你，因为你从来没真的站到她面前。
en: An imagined option will never reject you, because you have never actually stood before her.

text: 同龄女却会当面提要求、问收入、看房子，每一次见面都可能是一次具体的否定。
en: Yet a same-age woman will state her requirements to your face, ask about income, look at the flat; every meeting could be a concrete rejection.

text: 人很自然会躲开那个会让自己难堪的真实选项，守着那个永远不会拒绝自己的幻想。
en: People naturally dodge the real option that would embarrass them, and cling to the fantasy that will never reject them.

text: 再从他的角度看看这桩婚姻的投入产出。
en: Now look at the input and output of this marriage from his perspective.

text: 40女要的是被照顾，可能还带着孩子，还有她的父母要养老。
en: What a 40-year-old woman wants is to be cared for; she may also bring children, and her own parents need elderly care.

text: 他这边能得到的，生孩子大概率没戏，”有人照顾我”这一项又恰好是对方想从他身上拿的。
en: What he can get in return: having children is most likely hopeless, and the item 'someone to care for me' is precisely what the other side wants to take from him.

text: 对一个手头不宽裕的男人来说，这像是凭空多养一家子人，换来的东西他又看不太清。
en: For a man who is not well off, this is like suddenly having to support a whole extra family, while what he gets in return is something he cannot quite see clearly.

text: 这么一想，”宁可单着”在他那里是讲得通的。
en: Thinking this way, 'would rather stay single' makes sense for him.

text: 男人对自己”不贬值”有误判
en: Men misjudge their own 'non-depreciation'.

text: 还有一层是观念上的。
en: There is another layer, at the level of ideas.

text: 很多男人默认”男人四十一枝花”，觉得女人的价值跟年龄挂钩，男人不会。
en: Many men take for granted that 'a man of forty is still a flower', feeling that a woman's value is tied to age, but a man's is not.

text: 这种自我评估在优质男身上还有点道理，放到普通男身上就偏差很大了。
en: This self-assessment holds some truth for high-quality men, but applied to ordinary men the deviation is large.

text: 国外婚恋网站有个很出名的数据。
en: A foreign dating website has a very famous dataset.

text: OkCupid的联合创始人Christian Rudder在2014年出了本书叫《Dataclysm》，用网站数据分析了用户的偏好。
en: Christian Rudder, co-founder of OkCupid, published a book called Dataclysm in 2014, using the site's data to analyse users' preferences.

text: 他发现从20岁到50岁，男性用户给打分最高的女性几乎都是20岁出头。
en: He found that from age 20 to 50, the women rated highest by male users were almost all in their early twenties.

text: 用他的话说就是男人年纪长了，审美没长。
en: In his words, men grow older but their aesthetic does not.

text: 但同一份数据还有后半截，很多人转述时漏掉了：真到发消息的时候，男性倾向于联系比自己小十岁左右的女性，Rudder把这叫做某种妥协和讨价还价。
en: But the same dataset has a second half that many omit when retelling: when it actually comes to sending messages, men tend to contact women about ten years younger than themselves, which Rudder calls a kind of compromise and bargaining.

text: 也就是说，男人心里最想要的和他真去争取的，中间隔着一段现实。
en: That is to say, between what men most want in their hearts and what they actually go after, there lies a stretch of reality.

text: 这份数据要说清楚适用范围：样本是美国OkCupid用户，打分不等于结婚选择，也不能直接套到中国县城的相亲市场上。
en: This data needs its scope made clear: the sample is American OkCupid users; ratings do not equal marriage choices, nor can it be directly applied to the matchmaking markets of Chinese county towns.

text: 我没查到国内平台公开过同口径的数据。
en: I could not find that any domestic platform has published data on the same basis.

text: 但”偏好不随年龄变、行动会打折”这个规律，在你们婚介一线应该很眼熟。
en: But the pattern of 'preferences do not change with age, yet action gets discounted' should be very familiar on your matchmaking front line.

text: 那些宁可单着的普通40男，问题就出在行动这一步没打折。
en: Those ordinary 40-year-old men who would rather stay single — the problem is precisely that this step of action does not get discounted for them.

text: 他偏好的还是年轻的，行动上也只肯朝年轻的使劲，结果两头落空。
en: What he prefers is still the young, and in action he will only exert himself towards the young, ending up empty-handed on both fronts.

text: 观念之外还有外部压力。
en: Beyond ideas, there is also external pressure.

text: 在不少地方，男人娶个40岁的、尤其是二婚的，会被亲戚背后说”捡剩的”。
en: In many places, if a man marries a 40-year-old, especially a divorced one, relatives will say behind his back that he is 'picking up leftovers'.

text: 老人那边更直接，想抱孙子，听说对方40了第一反应就是摇头。
en: The elders are even more direct: wanting to hold a grandson, on hearing the other party is 40 their first reaction is to shake their heads.

text: 他本人要是还有点犹豫，家里一反对就彻底打消了念头。
en: If he himself is still somewhat hesitant, a single objection from the family completely dispels the idea.

text: 剩下来的，本来就是最不肯松口的那批
en: Those who remain single were, from the start, the batch most unwilling to relent.

text: 这一点做婚介的人容易忽视，但对理解这个现象很重要。
en: This point is easily overlooked by those in the matchmaking business, but is important for understanding this phenomenon.

text: 你看到的40岁未婚男，是经过二十年筛选剩下来的。
en: The 40-year-old unmarried men you see are those left after two decades of filtering.

text: 愿意降低标准、肯将就、想得开的那些人，大多在30岁前后就已经结婚了。
en: Those willing to lower their standards, able to settle, and open-minded enough to let go mostly married around the age of 30.

text: 能单到40岁的，里面本来就集中了一批要求硬、不肯改、或者结婚意愿本来就不太强的人。
en: Those who can stay single to 40 naturally concentrate a batch of people with rigid requirements, unwilling to change, or whose marriage intent was never very strong.

text: 用”这批人”的表现去推断”40岁男人”整体，会觉得他们格外挑，其实是样本本身就偏了。
en: Using the behaviour of 'this group' to infer '40-year-old men' as a whole makes them seem exceptionally picky, but in fact the sample itself is biased.

text: 另外，单着的成本比很多人想的低。
en: Moreover, the cost of staying single is lower than many imagine.

text: 一个人过了十几二十年，生活习惯早就定型了，有手机、短视频、游戏、几个哥们，日子不算难熬。
en: Having lived alone for ten or twenty years, one's living habits are long since set; with a phone, short videos, games and a few mates, life is not unbearable.

text: 结婚反而要改作息、要顾及另一个人、要花一大笔钱。
en: Marriage, by contrast, requires changing one's routine, taking another person into account, and spending a large sum of money.

text: 对他来说，婚姻的门槛高、回报模糊，单身的代价却很小，这样一比，拖着不结就成了最省力的选项。
en: For him, marriage has a high threshold and blurred returns, while the cost of being single is small; compared like this, dragging one's feet about marrying becomes the least effortful option.

text: 不过”宁可单着”也没那么绝对。
en: Yet 'would rather stay single' is not so absolute either.

text: 回到前面那张表，40-44岁男性未婚6.4%，到45-49岁降到4.4%。
en: Returning to the table earlier, men aged 40-44 who never married are 6.4%, falling to 4.4% at 45-49.

text: 这是不同年龄的人放在同一年比较，有死亡、统计误差的影响，不能直接当成同一批人的变化，但大方向能看出来：40多岁未婚的男人里，还有一部分后来结了婚。
en: This compares people of different ages in the same year, affected by death and statistical error, and cannot be taken directly as the change within the same group of people; but the general direction can be seen: among unmarried men in their forties, a portion later got married.

text: 很多人的”不要同龄的”，撑到45岁左右就慢慢松动了，只是他们这几年嘴上还硬。
en: Many people's 'don't want same-age' slowly loosens by around 45, it is just that they stay stubborn in words for these few years.

text: 婚介这一行能做点什么
en: What the matchmaking trade can do.

text: 理解了原因，就能对症下药。
en: Once the cause is understood, the right remedy can be prescribed.

text: 下面几条是从上面的分析里推出来的，做法上可以试试：
en: The following points are drawn from the analysis above; they are worth a try in practice:

text: 先问清楚他到底为什么想结婚。
en: First ask clearly why on earth he wants to marry.

text: 如果主要是为了孩子，就跟他坦诚聊聊自己的年龄、身体和养孩子的现实，这比劝他”别挑了”更有用。
en: If it is mainly for children, then talk to him candidly about his own age, health and the reality of raising a child; this is more useful than urging him to 'stop being picky'.

text: 如果他其实不执着于孩子，图的是有个伴，那同龄女在他面前就有了优势，可以从陪伴、生活上互相照应这个角度去推荐。
en: If he is in fact not fixated on children and is after companionship, then same-age women have an advantage before him, and can be recommended from the angle of companionship and mutual care in daily life.

text: 给他推荐同龄女时，优先找那些对经济不要求”比我强”、能接受平等搭伙的人。
en: When recommending same-age women to him, prioritise those who do not demand 'better off than me' economically and can accept an equal partnership.

text: 这类女性人数不多，但正好能消掉他最怕的那份”考不过的试卷”。
en: Such women are not many in number, but they happen to dissolve that 'exam paper he cannot pass' that he fears most.

text: 在他有意愿的前提下，让他真实接触一两次年轻女性的反馈。
en: On the premise that he has the willingness, let him genuinely experience the feedback of young women one or two times.

text: 幻想只有被现实碰过一次，才会松动。
en: A fantasy only loosens once it has been bumped by reality.

text: 这一条要注意分寸，别弄得像在故意羞辱人。
en: This point requires a sense of proportion; do not make it look like deliberately humiliating someone.

text: 对女方那边，也可以说明普通40男的顾虑：怕被嫌钱少，怕一进门就当继父。
en: On the women's side, one can also explain the ordinary 40-year-old man's worries: fear of being thought too poor, fear of becoming a stepfather the moment he steps in.

text: 双方的担心摆到桌面上，比各自在心里打分容易谈成。
en: Putting both sides' worries on the table makes a deal easier than each silently scoring in their hearts.

text: 最后一句话总结：普通40男不要同龄女，多半是一种自我保护加上一份没想清楚的投入产出。
en: To sum up in one sentence: an ordinary 40-year-old man not wanting a same-age woman is mostly a form of self-protection plus an unclearly thought-through cost-benefit.

text: 他能碰到的同龄女多是离异带娃的，他最想要的孩子对方很难给，对方最想要的经济和照顾他又给不起，于是他干脆躲进”我要年轻的”这个永远不会被拒绝的想象里，一单就是好几年。
en: The same-age women he can meet are mostly divorced with children; the children he most wants, the other side can hardly give; the economic support and care the other side most wants, he cannot afford to give — so he simply hides in the never-to-be-rejected fantasy of 'I want someone young', staying single for years on end.
